text:
Subject: RE: Yarden Lounge Group Submission

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for thinking of us for Yarden Lounge Group.

Unfortunately, we'll need to pass on this opportunity. Nightclubs and bars with entertainment fall outside our current appetite for hospitality risks.

Given the nature of this exposure, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on entertainment venues—such markets often have programs tailored for nightclub operations and would be better positioned to provide competitive terms.

I appreciate you sending this our way, and please keep us in mind for other restaurant or hospitality submissions without entertainment components.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
